content:
STAGE: scope screen + evidence read (all 7 bundles are the same rubric template).
GOAL: check each of the 7 proposals against the 5 scope clauses before ranking, then ground each placement in the frozen evidence.
READ: all 7 idea texts and their bundles (E1-E14 each). Shared evidence: E5 successor-entropy stratification (top-1 mass 0.4375 low-entropy bin vs 0.0543 high, Spearman -0.973); E6 width-20 beam survival (l1_br recall 0.04671 with gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068; l1_br_euclid 0.06207 with 0.829/0.161/0.085; l1_only 0.06233; resample 0.06363; successor_geodesic 0.0550; tangent_successor_residual 0.0550); E7 teacher-forced NLL (T3 4.36 for the working variants vs T1/T2 ~0, T4 1.19-1.23; l1_br T4 9.03); E8 K-ceiling (share of behavioural pairs sharing a cluster 0.3106 at K=16 vs 0.0822 at K=256); E9 cohort-profile signal (positive shares cohort 0.9291 vs 0.8871 negatives; profile overlap beats all ten negatives in 0.5898 of pairs, entropy 1.65 nats); E10 mean out-degree 5.45; E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067.
OBSERVED: all 7 name a train-only behaviour statistic with a computation, all name an explicit curved operation with a location, and all define behaviour-off / Euclidean / both-on switches, so no proposal is auto-rejected on scope clause 1, 2, 4 or 5. Clause 3 (real coupling) is the discriminator: weakest in GYRO-BEHAFF-SID (gyro-sub residual is a monotone reparametrisation of d_P, so curvature is near-gauge) and CGREP-4L-RQ (d_P only inside a hinge); strongest in BCMID-L3-RQ, HOLO-TILT-L3 and BEHDIR-L4 where curvature supplies the address/angle/walk. Clause 3 is broken by HOLO-TILT-L3 in practice: the query is rotated but the codebook stays canonical and no inverse rotation enters reconstruction.
EVIDENCE PATTERN I USED FOR PLACEMENT: E7 says the first three positions are saturated-to-degenerate and a fourth position is cheap and learnable (T4 NLL 1.19-1.23), while E6/E11 say behaviour is only weakly aligned with the existing text prefixes (0.0907 vs null 0.067) and E8 says finer text partitions scatter behavioural neighbours. Together these favour mechanisms that keep L1-L3 text geometry and add a cheap, behaviour-labelled deep digit, and disfavour mechanisms that rewrite L2/L3 assignment.
OPEN: convert the pattern into a strict order; verify claims each proposal makes about the bundle numbers (done: HOLO-TILT-L3 cites 0.0678 as the frozen baseline, but in E6 0.0678 is l1_br's "target SID inside the 20 beams", and l1_br is the prefix-degenerate variant with gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068).

STAGE: mechanism-level technical checks that decided the order.
READ: the specifications of all 7, plus E6/E7/E8/E9/E10/E11.
OBSERVED, per idea:
(a) GYRO-BEHAFF-SID: with x⊖y = x⊕(−y), ‖x⊖c‖ = ‖(−c)⊕x‖ = tanh(d_P(x,c)/2); the residual norm is a monotone transform of the Poincare distance to the chosen codeword, so it cannot lift r³ off zero when a codeword fits - the stated cure for the 1.04-codes-per-cell collapse is not a cure. With c=1 gauge-fixed by its own admission, the Poincare argmin differs from the Euclidean one only by a per-codeword 1/(1-‖c_k‖²) weight. New content is really the 512-code L2, which E8 says scatters behavioural neighbours (0.0822 at K=256).
(b) BCMID-L3-RQ: Lorentz midpoint address puts behaviour inside the argmin; behaviour-off changes the address point, curvature-off changes the Voronoi cell, so coupling is real and not a reparametrisation; centred successor contrast directly deletes the hub component that E6 shows cost round two (0.0517). Constants derived (median aperture R, median R_b, rank at 90% energy, clamp 3). Cost small.
(c) CGREP-4L-RQ: sign of the evidence is read correctly (E6: both losses came from attractive displacement, 2201->1298 L3 prefixes, 0.0544->0.0517); hinge margin is the measured median initial d_P and lambda is normalised at step 0, so damage is bounded. Weakness: curvature only enters as d_P inside a hinge; and contrast is computed on items with mean out-degree 5.45 (E10), so impostor ranking is noisy.
(d) HOLO-TILT-L3: theta = pi/2 - alpha - beta with alpha=atan(tanh(b)/sinh(a_i)), beta=atan(tanh(a_i)/sinh(b)) goes to ~pi/2 (near 90 deg) for large a_i,b, i.e. exactly at depth, so the deepest token is close to a random rotation of the residual; and the query is rotated while the codebook stays in one canonical frame with no inverse rotation in the loss, so error becomes ‖r_i - Rot_i r_i‖. Its motivation also cites 0.0678 as the frozen baseline, but E6 gives 0.0678 as l1_br's beam-oracle "target SID inside the 20 beams".
(e) BISECT-L4-ASYM: strictly additive fourth digit keyed by (l1,l2,l3,child); children born on per-cell equal-mass asymmetry quantiles so balance is structural; c = (1/(1.2R))² derived from the measured initial radius; two-anchor weighted geodesic score means the curvature is not a pure gauge. Matches E7's cheap, learnable fourth position and E8's warning against widening L1/L2.
(f) HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ: loss unchanged, 3-token Stage-3 protocol unchanged, children capped at 0.5x the measured codebook spacing so it is a bounded no-op when contrast is uninformative and can only split, never merge. Weakness: one binary behaviour bit per anchor plus a fixed random projection of a 24556-dim contrast.
(g) BEHDIR-L4: keeps L1-L3 recipe, adds a geodesic fourth token whose direction mixes the conformal-normalised text residual with the successor-profile direction; s0 is a measured mean distance and s is clamped, gate W=0 at init. Weakness: the PPMI transition row is symmetrised (T+T^T)/2, discarding the directedness E5 shows is concentrated; 64 global codes can become a prefix-independent behaviour id.
CONCLUSION: order BISECT > BEHDIR > HYSPLIT > BCMID > CGREP > GYRO > HOLO, on the E7 fourth-position headroom, E8/E11 warning against fine-partition behaviour forcing, and the per-idea technical defects above.

STAGE: final answer (complete ranking, one line per proposal, 7 proposals, positions 1..7 no ties).
RANK: BISECT-L4-ASYM | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 put the headroom at a fourth position (T3 NLL 4.36 vs T4 1.19-1.23) and E8/E11 warn that widening or re-forcing the text prefixes scatters behaviour (K=256 share 0.0822 vs K=16 0.3106; SID-behaviour alignment 0.0907 vs null 0.067), so a per-cell 4-symbol digit born on equal-mass asymmetry quantiles adds deep capacity with no item displacement, structural child balance, curvature derived as (1/(1.2R))^2 from the measured radius, and a two-anchor score where c is not a pure gauge.
RANK: BEHDIR-L4 | position=2 | reason=keeps the L1-L3 recipe and rides the same evidenced position-4 headroom, and its behaviour enters as the canonical successor profile (E9: profile overlap beats all ten negatives in 0.5898 of pairs, cohort share 0.9291 vs 0.8871) inside a genuine log/exp-at-prefix walk with s0 measured and s clamped; below BISECT because its PPMI row is symmetrised, discarding the directed signal E5 shows is concentrated (top-1 mass 0.4375 in the low-entropy bin), and its 64 global codes can collapse into a prefix-independent behaviour id.
RANK: HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ | position=3 | reason=the only mechanism that buys deep capacity with the 3-token Stage-3 protocol and the loss unchanged, children being exp-map offsets capped at half the measured codebook spacing, so it is a bounded no-op when the E9 contrast is uninformative and it can only split, never merge (the failure that took round two to 0.0517); below the 4-token ideas because the doubling is one binary behaviour bit per anchor and a fixed random projection of a 24556-dim contrast can wash the signal out.
RANK: BCMID-L3-RQ | position=4 | reason=best coupling of the L3-rewrite family (Lorentz midpoint address changes the argmin point and the Klein cell, so neither switch is a reparametrisation) and its centred contrast deletes the hub that E6 shows cost round two; below the deep-capacity ideas because it must repair the hardest level (E6 depth-3 prefix survival 0.161, E7 T3 NLL 4.36) and its own Lorentz midpoint contracts toward the weak-curvature centre it admits as a risk.
RANK: CGREP-4L-RQ | position=5 | reason=reads the sign of the evidence correctly (E6: 2201->1298 L3 prefixes and 0.0544->0.0517 came from attractive displacement) and bounds the damage with a hinge margin equal to the measured median initial d_P and lambda normalised at step 0; placed below BCMID because curvature enters only as d_P inside a hinge (a Euclidean hinge would behave almost identically) and the impostor contrast rests on items with mean out-degree 5.45 (E10).
RANK: GYRO-BEHAFF-SID | position=6 | reason=in scope but the geometry is near-gauge: with x⊖c the residual norm is tanh(d_P(x,c)/2), a monotone transform that cannot lift r^3 off zero when a codeword fits, so the claimed cure for the 19.6-items-per-L2-cell / 1.04-L3-codes collapse does not follow, and with c=1 fixed by its own admission the curved argmin is a per-codeword 1/(1-‖c_k‖^2) reweight; the only new content is 512 codes at L2/L3, which E8's measured ceiling says scatters behavioural neighbours.
RANK: HOLO-TILT-L3 | position=7 | reason=its rotation acts on the query while the codebook stays in one canonical frame with no inverse rotation in the loss, so the quantised residual approximates Rot_i r_i and the error becomes ‖r_i-Rot_i r_i‖; and the defect theta=pi/2-alpha-beta goes to ~90 deg for large a_i,b, i.e. at depth, so the deepest token is a near-arbitrary rotation; its grounding also misreads E6, where 0.0678 is l1_br's beam-oracle "target SID inside the 20 beams", not the frozen baseline, and l1_br is the prefix-degenerate variant (gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068).
